data.name: Naren
data.gender_notes: Naren is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Nara’ (human) and ‘Rama’ (delight), Naren translates to ‘Lord’s Delight’. In Hindu mythology, Naren is an epithet for Lord Vishnu and represents the divine joy of existence. The name Naren carries the meaning “Lord's Delight” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Naren usually hope their child will grow to embody lord's delight and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Naren belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord's Delight.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Naren total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
